title: Warmly Rendered Spanish Tomatoes Pa Amb Tomaquet
description: A cultured and crunchy Spanish dish featuring seasoned tomatoes, rendered fat, and paleo-friendly ingredients, served in a copper pot.
instructions: Preheat the copper pot over medium heat, adding the pork fat to melt and render.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly to prevent burning.
Add the smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper, stirring to combine.
Add the sliced tomatoes, cooking for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally, until they start to break down.
Use a fork to gently crush the tomatoes, releasing their juices and creating a sauce.
Continue cooking for an additional 10 minutes, stirring frequently, until the sauce has thickened.
Stir in the chopped fresh basil and cook for 1 minute, allowing the flavors to meld.
Serve the pa amb tomaquet hot, garnished with additional basil if desired.
